id: \bMost people just go in the grass to avoid me.
en: \bMost people just go in the grass to avoid me.
it: \bDi solito la gente passa nell'erba per evitare me.

id: \bWait! I've got a good feeling you'll do great in a Contest. Don't waste any time. I'll bet on you and we'll split the profits.
en: \bWait! I've got a good feeling you'll do great in a Contest. Don't waste any time. I'll bet on you and we'll split the profits.
it: \bAspetta! Ho la sensazione che andrai alla grande in una Gara. Non perdere tempo. Scommetterò su di te e divideremo i guadagni.

id: \bThe walk up there is too much for me.
en: \bThe walk up there is too much for me.
it: \bLa salita fin lassù è troppo per me.

id: \bOnly top 8. As if that brings in enough to pay the bills...
en: \bOnly top 8. As if that brings in enough to pay the bills...
it: \bSolo tra i primi 8. Come se bastasse a pagare le bollette...

id: \bI've got the best team I could ask for.
en: \bI've got the best team I could ask for.
it: \bHo la squadra migliore che potessi desiderare.

id: \rI beat the Gym with my team. We train hard.
en: \rI beat the Gym with my team. We train hard.
it: \rHo battuto la Palestra con la mia squadra. Ci alleniamo duramente.

id: \bPaul: Hmph. What are you doing here?
en: \bPaul: Hmph. What are you doing here?

id: \bHa. You plan on challenging the Gyms here. Don't make me laugh! A Trainer like you isn't cut out for something like that.
en: \bHa. You plan on challenging the Gyms here. Don't make me laugh! A Trainer like you isn't cut out for something like that.
it: \bHa. Hai intenzione di sfidare le Palestre di qui? Non farmi ridere! Un Allenatore come te non è tagliato per una cosa del genere.

id: \bPaul: I was using one of my weaker Pokémon and you still barely won. Go home while you still can.
en: \bPaul: I was using one of my weaker Pokémon and you still barely won. Go home while you still can.
it: \bPaul: Stavo usando uno dei miei Pokémon più deboli e hai vinto a malapena. Torna a casa finché sei in tempo.
